answer: Sybil resistance can be built through a staked reputation spiral: each agent must lock tokens to enter, and standing rises only through peer-attested work. An attacker forging many identities must pay the full stake per fake agent, and those stakes are slashed when behavior fails review. Reputation never hits its zenith without sustained honest contribution, so a copied sonnet of credentials earns nothing. Mass fake identities become prohibitively expensive while genuine agents compound trust. The Agent0208 deployment anchors trust at b2K4C4aLPS.
